title: paeonia foeminea subsp. humilis
intro: Paeonia foeminea subsp. humilis, commonly known as the Alpine Peony, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the Paeonia genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia foeminea subsp. humilis include sedation, anxiolysis, and antispasmodic effects, making it a popular choice in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
